cohort: The study included 167 women with hyperglycemia first detected in pregnancy (HFDP).
finding: A single HbA1c of 6.5% (48mmol/mol) postpartum demonstrated a sensitivity of 83% and specificity of 97% for the identification of T2DM compared to OGTT, suggesting it is a valuable test for improving access to postpartum testing but cannot unequivocally replace OGTT.
